formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene–oxymethylene copolymer with randomly-spaced oxy-methylene units inserted into linear PEO chain (n~9, m~600).
formulations.Notes: Conductivity data reported as log10(sigma) vs dopant level (Li:O ratio) in Fig. 5. Specific formulations tested include Li:O ratios of 24:1, 16:1, 12:1, 8:1, 64:1, and 1:1. Salt concentration is not explicitly stated as weight percent in the text, only as molar ratios. Conductivity values are read from Fig. 5 table.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden and J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000
